title: The Great Gatsby
description: Later printing of Fitzgerald's classic in the original green cloth. Spine slightly sunned, light shelf wear, text clean and tight. No dust jacket.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
description: Illustrated edition with Tenniel's drawings. Gilt-stamped red cloth, bright and square, a few faint foxing spots to the endpapers.
author: Lewis Carroll

title: A Field Guide to the Birds
description: Second revised edition with color plates. Cloth boards with rubbing at the corners, a previous owner's name on the front endpaper.
author: Roger Tory Peterson

title: The Joy of Cooking
description: Well-loved mid-century kitchen copy. Binding sound, some food stains and handwritten notes in the margins, which add to its charm.
author: Irma S. Rombauer

title: Leaves of Grass
description: Turn-of-the-century edition of Whitman's poems in decorative cloth. Hinges firm, edges lightly worn, small bookplate inside the front cover.
author: Walt Whitman

title: The Hobbit
description: Early paperback printing with the Tolkien-drawn cover. Creased spine, pages toned with age, complete and readable.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien

title: Grimm's Fairy Tales
description: Illustrated by Arthur Rackham with tipped-in color plates. Decorated cloth, all plates present, light toning.
author: Brothers Grimm; illus. Arthur Rackham
